description: Judges a k6 load-test run, rather than restating its numbers. Two answers kept apart: whether the thresholds the team wrote in their own k6 script held, and whether this run is slower than the recorded baseline. The second is answered only from three or more baseline runs - below that it returns 'cannot say', because one run against one run cannot distinguish a regression from a busy machine, and a percentage printed without that distinction is how performance tooling gets ignored. It never predicts a duration, a capacity or a user impact, and it says what the run does not cover. Use it when asked whether a change made something slower.

label.description: Which load test this is, so two different suites do not become each other baseline
